edges.reason: msg.sender is used in bid() as the new winning bidder and bidder identity
block.timestamp gates bid() (start, end and 15-minute extension)
tx.origin is compared with msg.sender in bid() as an access restriction
live() depends directly on block.timestamp < endTime
startTime is required to be reached before bidding
endTime is read and extended with now inside bid()
endTime is read by live() for the auction state
lastBid.mul(110).div(100) computes the minimum next bid
the address controlled by a previous msg.sender (winning) receives ETH via transfer
bid() performs the external ETH transfer before updating lastBid/winning
lastBid state update happens after the external transfer, allowing reentrant bids
winning is the recipient of the refund transfer
require(!ended) guards end()
require(winning != address(0)) guards end()
require(!live()) guards end()
end() calls the external ERC1155 safeTransferFrom on the token contract before setting ended
end() sends the house fee via an external ETH transfer
end() sends the remaining balance to the seller via an external ETH transfer
haus (payable address) is the recipient of haus.transfer
seller (payable address) is the recipient of seller.transfer
end() reads address(this).balance into the local variable balance
local balance is not used directly but co-determines the payout split
seller.transfer sends the remaining contract balance
hausFee is derived from balance.div(20).mul(3)
hausFee is the amount passed to haus.transfer
require(!ended) guards pull()
require(!live()) guards pull()
pull() performs an external ERC1155 transfer before flipping ended
token address is the target contract of the ERC1155 call in end()
token address is the target contract of the ERC1155 call in pull()
ERC1155 safeTransferFrom invokes the receiver hook, potentially reentering end() before ended is set
ERC1155 safeTransferFrom callback can reenter pull() while ended is still false
safeTransferFrom triggers the onERC1155Received hook on the receiving contract
constructor computes endTime = startTime + length

normalization_plan.reason: local variable balance is only a temporary holder of address(this).balance inside end() and does not carry independent semantics
local variable hausFee exists solely to compute the amount passed to haus.transfer and should be merged into that unsafe operation
